from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs/task-bc9e8f55.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    markers = [[grid[r][c] != background for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r in range(h):\n        cols = [c for c in range(w) if markers[r][c]]\n        for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):\n            if 2 <= b - a <= 3:\n                for c in range(a + 1, b):\n                    out[r][c] = 2\n    for c in range(w):\n        rows = [r for r in range(h) if markers[r][c]]\n        for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:]):\n            if 2 <= b - a <= 3:\n                for r in range(a + 1, b):\n                    out[r][c] = 2\n    return out\n'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),globals())
